text:
46세 남성 환자, severe sepsis with perforated diverticulitis.  
BP 85/60 mmHg, HR 125 bpm, RR 28 breaths/min, BT 39.0°C, SpO2 89% (room air).  
Severe abdominal pain 호소함.  
Piperacillin/Tazobactam 4.5g IV q8h 투여 중.  
High-flow nasal cannula 적용함.  
Fluid resuscitation 시행함.  
C-line 유지함.  
Positive fluid balance 확인됨.  
환자 drowsy 상태임.
